name: Leopold Museum
notes: Fetches /de/ausstellungen (current, 3 shows) + /de/ausstellungen/vorschau (upcoming, 2 shows), no ld+json or API. Server-rendered <article class="exhibition"> cards with title, subtitle, and a German date range string parsed by hand (en-dash separated, 'Seit DD.MM.YYYY' means permanent -> end null + extra.permanent true). No category or price shown anywhere on listing or detail pages, so both are always null. There's also /de/ausstellungen/archiv for past shows, intentionally not fetched.
